scope: One independent SECCA CAD generation per model, native validation, fixed white renders, three evidence-bound visual reviews per output; no model-wide ranking or speed superiority claim
resource_policy: Separate per-trial candidates/gateways/work/home/channel volumes. Candidate network none; no host binds. Same existing runtime, parallel allocation; timings are descriptive single-run values only.
review_policy: Identity-aware coordinator freezes initial review before two fresh-context model-blinded independent reviews for each output; sum per-criterion medians.
